cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; a private present-day sleeper-train compartment beside a large window — waking from a nap and reaching to close the window blind as the train enters a station; a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a stairwell landing with a tall window — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a far-future orbital visitor centre with a miniature rotating planetarium dome and an empty curved demonstration dais — taking a break by pretending to host the planetarium show; a floating sky garden of hanging vines and flowering terraces above the clouds — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a space-station lounge bar — seated on a chair; a sunny enclosed veranda with drying racks overhead — lying on her left side; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — holds a white feather fan upright at chest height; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — dries her hair with a towel; her bedroom — standing; a circus tent ring under a striped canopy — perched on a ledge or edge; an ice palace hall of carved crystal pillars — standing
